claims: Germany won 5-1 against Austria in women's football on April 14, 2026.
Germany's 5-1 win against Austria was in 2026 World Cup qualifiers.
Austria was separated from Germany after the 1866 Austro-Prussian War.
Austria was not part of the German Empire formed in 1871.
Germany has a much larger economy than Austria.
Germany and Austria share a language
